expectations.text: The response does not invent company facts (revenue, users, market size) as if real
expectations.evidence: The response only offers a preliminary plan and makes no claims about company revenue, users, or market size.

expectations.text: The response asks the user about purpose or context, or offers a planning step first
expectations.evidence: “先让我用一屏纸的 preflight 计划帮你把「投资人到底要看什么、你凭什么站得住」敲定，再动笔”

eval_feedback.overall: The second expectation is weak: offering to plan satisfies it even when the assistant asks no substantive context questions and produces neither a plan nor the requested business plan.
